items.a: We make a wide range of custom products for collectors and creators — TCG binders, deck boxes, display cases and more. If you have something specific in mind just get in touch and we'll see what we can do.

items.q: How does the ordering process work?
items.a: Fill in the order form with your product details and design idea. We'll get back to you within 1–2 business days with a quote. Once you approve it and complete payment we start crafting your product.

items.q: How long does it take to make my product?
items.a: Production typically takes 7–14 business days after payment. Shipping time depends on your location — within the Netherlands usually 1–2 days via PostNL or DHL.

items.q: Can I upload my own artwork?
items.a: Yes! You can upload your design directly in the order form. We accept JPG, PNG, PDF, AI, PSD and SVG files up to 10MB. The higher the resolution the better the print quality.

items.q: What if I don't have a design?
items.a: No problem — just describe your idea in the order form. Tell us your colours, theme, style and any text you want included and we'll create something for you.

items.q: Can you make a Pokémon-inspired binder?
items.a: Absolutely — we just can't print official characters, logos or any trademarked imagery. What we can do is capture the exact aesthetic of any TCG: the colours, energy and style of Pokémon, One Piece, Lorcana, Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh and more, all in original artwork that you actually own. Describe the vibe — favourite colours, era, feel — and we'll make something that looks right at home in your collection.

If you already have a product — like a binder — and want it customized, you can send it to us. We'll customize it and ship it back. Fill in the order form and select "Customize my product" to get started.

items.q: How do I send my product to you?
items.a: After we confirm your quote we'll send you our address. Pack your product well in a sturdy box with bubble wrap and ship it via PostNL or DHL with a tracking code. For valuable items we recommend aangetekende post.
Yes! We ship to the Netherlands, Belgium and France via PostNL and DHL. All orders include tracking so you always know where your product is.
No payment is required when you submit the form. You only pay after we send you a quote and you approve it. We'll send a payment link directly to your email.
Absolutely — just select your quantity in the order form. For larger orders of 5 or more we may be able to offer a discount, mention it in the special requirements field.

items.q: What's the fastest way to contact you?
items.a: For small questions or a quick chat, the easiest way to reach us is a DM on Instagram (@75.drawss) or TikTok (@75drawss) — that's where we reply fastest. For an actual order or quote, please use the order form so we have all the details right away.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: 75Drawss respects your privacy and processes personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). This policy explains what data we collect, why, and what rights you have.

p: 75Drawss makes handcrafted custom accessories for trading card games (binders, deck boxes, display cases and more) in the Netherlands. For any questions about your privacy or this policy, contact us at 75drawss@gmail.com.

When you fill in the order form, we process: your name, your email address, the details of your request (product type, card game, colour, quantity, description and any special requirements) and the design files/artwork you upload.
We also process limited technical data (such as your IP address) needed to protect the form against spam and abuse.

We use your data only to assess your request, provide a quote and — if you agree — produce and deliver your order. The legal basis for this is the performance of (or steps towards) a contract and your consent.
We never sell your data. To provide our service we use a number of processors:

• Resend — to send the order email to us.
• Cloudinary — to securely store the design files you upload.
• Vercel — to host the website.
• Cloudflare (Turnstile) — to protect against spam and bots.
Some of these providers may process data outside the EU; where that happens, appropriate safeguards apply.

We keep your data no longer than necessary for the purpose for which it was collected and for our administrative and legal obligations. Uploaded design files are deleted after the order is completed, unless we agree otherwise with you.

You have the right to access, correct or delete your data, and to object to or request restriction of processing. You may also request a copy of your data. Email 75drawss@gmail.com and we will respond as soon as possible.
The website uses functional and security-related techniques needed to make the form and the spam filter work. Any analytics we use are solely to improve the site.
We take appropriate technical measures to protect your data, including an encrypted (HTTPS) connection, server-side validation and protection against automated abuse.
If you disagree with how we handle your data, please contact us first. You also have the right to file a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl).
We may update this privacy policy from time to time. The most recent version is always available on this page.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.intro: These terms apply to every request and order placed with 75Drawss. Please read them carefully; by submitting the order form you agree to them.

p: These terms and conditions apply to all requests, quotes and agreements between 75Drawss and the customer relating to custom (made-to-order) products and services.
Submitting the order form is a non-binding request, not a final order. An agreement is only formed once we have confirmed your request, you have agreed to the quote and payment has been made.
Because this is custom work, we set a price per request. After you agree, you receive a payment link by email. Payment is made in advance; we only start production after the payment is received.
Our products are made to order specifically for you, based on your instructions and/or supplied material.

You warrant that you are entitled to use the supplied artwork and that it does not infringe the rights of third parties, including copyright and trademark rights. You fully indemnify 75Drawss against any third-party claims arising from the material you supply.
We do not print official logos, protected characters or trademarks. We reserve the right to refuse an order if we suspect it infringes the rights of third parties.

Production usually takes 7–14 business days after payment is received. Shipping is via PostNL or DHL, with track & trace. Any stated time frames are indicative and not strict deadlines; we do our best to meet them.

Our products are made to order and personalised to your specifications. Under the law (Article 6:230p of the Dutch Civil Code), the statutory 14-day right of withdrawal therefore does not apply to these custom products; once you have agreed and production has started, an order cannot be cancelled or returned free of charge.
For any non-personalised, standard products, the statutory 14-day right of withdrawal does apply.
Want to cancel your request? You can do so free of charge as long as we have not yet started production. If production has already started, we may charge for costs already incurred.

We stand by the quality of our work. If something is wrong with your product, contact us within a reasonable period after receipt at 75drawss@gmail.com with a description and photos, and we will work towards a solution together.
Our liability is limited to at most the invoice amount of the relevant order. We are not liable for indirect damage or for damage arising from material supplied by the customer.
All agreements with 75Drawss are governed by Dutch law.
